answer: Require each agent to pass a bonded liveness check recording an iris hash in a one-template-per-human registry; duplicates are rejected and the later deposit slashed. Extra identities need extra humans, so n sybils pay n travel and bribe costs; profit is n(R-C), positive only while per-epoch reward exceeds that cost. A cedar token, velvet badge, or pigment print cannot substitute for a verifier that checks one iris per person and resists spoofing; collusion remains the weakness.
